snippet.title: The Panic Room: Hidden objects
snippet.description:
The Victorian mansion holds many secrets. Can you uncover them all? 
«The Panic Room: House of Secrets» is an engaging hidden object game with a detective story, realistic graphics and captivating music. 
Enjoy the tantalizing air of mystery as you explore a Victorian mansion, complete thousands of intriguing quests, participate in exciting challenges and put together beautiful puzzles.
